metadata.mechanics: This benediction consecrates a 10x10 area, with the size adjustable by game runner approval. The ritual involves decorating the space and performing specific rites unique to the faith a space is being consecrated to. The ritual takes a minimum of 30 minutes, reduced by 5 minutes per additional Inducted participant of the same faith, with a minimum of 10 minutes. The duration can be extended at player discretion for more in-depth role-playing. The consecrated area must be recorded on a Local Plot Card that expires at the end of the event.
metadata.notes: This space must be decorated appropriately and requires Director approval.
metadata.requirementsToUse: Lore: Faith - Common OR Any Basic Faithful Development skill. User must be Inducted to a canon faith.
metadata.validTargetDescription: 10x10 area, adjusted by game runner approval
metadata.locationOfUse: Any appropriate non ""Zone of Play"" space
metadata.descriptionOfRoleplay: 30 minutes of role-play cleaning, preparing, decorating, and dedicating a space to a specific faith. Consecrated spaces are not subtle and require extensive props and genre / faith appropriate decorations for the Ritual of Consecration to work. The 30 minutes of role-play may be reduced by 5 minutes per assisting member of the same faith that engages in active participation of the ritual (ritual cannot be reduced under 10 minutes).
metadata.activationRequirement: None. Role-play and appropriate set dressing.
